item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Tara looks at the diagram. Parallel lines $m$ and $n$ are cut by transversal $t$. One same-side interior angle is marked $75^{\circ}$.

Which claim correctly gives the other same-side interior angle?

options.A: Call the answer the transversal $t$, and stop.
options.B: The other same-side interior angle is $75^{\circ}$, because those angles are equal.
options.C: The other same-side interior angle is $105^{\circ}$, because same-side interior angles on parallel lines add to $180^{\circ}$.
options.D: The other same-side interior angle is $150^{\circ}$, from doubling $75^{\circ}$.
